script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.progress_percent, j.progress_message, j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at, j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.row_version, j.error_code, j.error_message, j.error_details, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.is_deleted, j.line_count,
       IF(JSON_VALID(j.request_payload), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.prevStatus')), NULL) AS prev_status
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS ia_id, g.item_assembly_status, g.ia_v2_job_id AS ia_v2_job_id, g.stock_movement_no,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('IAC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN sm_item_assembly g ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.jobId}} AND j.correlation_id REGEXP '^IA\\|[0-9]{1,20}$'

script.code:
SELECT CAST(m.id AS CHAR) AS id, m.transaction_type, m.movement, m.trx_no, CAST(m.item_id AS CHAR) AS item_id,
       CAST(m.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id, CAST(m.bin_location_id AS CHAR) AS bin_location_id, CAST(m.batch_number_id AS CHAR) AS batch_number_id,
       CAST(m.handling_unit_id AS CHAR) AS handling_unit_id, m.inventory_category, m.quantity, m.base_qty, CAST(m.uom_id AS CHAR) AS uom_id,
       CAST(m.base_uom_id AS CHAR) AS base_uom_id, m.unit_price, m.total_price, m.costing_method_id
  FROM inventory_movement m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND m.id > {{node:code_node_IVCentry.data.iaId}}
   AND m.organization_id = (SELECT h.organization_id FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVCentry.data.iaId}})
   AND m.trx_no = (SELECT h.stock_movement_no FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVCentry.data.iaId}})
   AND m.transaction_type IN ('IA', 'IA-R')
   AND m.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY m.id

script.code:
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id, lock_key, free_token, owner_operation_id, last_owner_operation_id, lock_version,
       DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now
  FROM inventory_balance_lock
 WHERE tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IVCentry.data.organizationId}}'
   AND balance_type = 'COST'
   AND free_token = 0
   AND (owner_operation_id = 'IAV|{{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.jobId}}|C' OR (COALESCE(owner_operation_id, '') = '' AND last_owner_operation_id = 'IAV|{{node:code_node_IVCguard.data.jobId}}|C'))
   AND is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY lock_key
